answer: Entry fees here scale with funding origin. The ledger groups accounts whose deposits trace to one source wallet into a reef, and the k-th member of a reef pays k^2 opal to join, with a nadir of 1 opal for a lone account. So 1,000 sybils from one source cost about 334 million opal, not 1,000. Hidden links found later trigger back-billing from stake. Colluders cannot split the bill: pooling funds merges them into one reef. Honest agents pay 1 opal once.
